result.evidence_quote: Bis-(di-4-phenyl-benzylaminethiocarbonyl)disulfide reverses cisplatin resistance in a cisplatin-resistant variant of A549 cells (via ALDH and ABCC2 inhibition) but not in NCI-H158 cells.
result.rationale: The study directly addresses molecular mechanisms of chemotherapy resistance in lung cancer and tests an experimental treatment enhancer. It also identifies ABCC2 and ALDH3A1 overexpression as potential biomarkers for selecting patients who could benefit.
